notes.title: 23rd August: The Birth of the worldline Laedrum
notes.notes:
On the 23rd of August, 2017, the worldline Laedrum was created by the "Purge". Will this worldline become a part of Laedrum?
Find out more about the lore in the game!

To celebrate the birth of the worldline Laedrum - which is the worldline of this game from the XorceD series - the game "XorceD - Sashiro's Laedrum" will be on a special sale! It will be 25% off for ten days.
